title: Apply --filter flag from Commander to TasksApp
description: Pass the --filter option from Commander to TasksApp as the initialFilter prop, so the app starts with the specified filter pre-applied.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket tasks --filter incomplete starts with the Incomplete filter active
rocket tasks --filter complete starts with the Complete filter active
rocket tasks --filter blocked starts with the Blocked filter active
rocket tasks (no filter) starts with All filter

steps.description: Read --filter option in tasks.ts command handler
steps.details: In src/commands/tasks.ts, extract the filter option: const { filter } = options. Validate it's one of 'incomplete', 'complete', 'blocked' or undefined.
When rendering TasksApp: render(<TasksApp tasks={tasks} agentDir={agentDir} initialFilter={filter || 'all'} />)

steps.description: Initialize filter state from prop in TasksApp
steps.details: In TasksApp, initialize filter state with the prop: useState<FilterType>(initialFilter as FilterType || 'all')
